# Security traceability: 0001-local-stage-loop

<!-- Written by the security-requirements-auditor. Do not edit by hand. -->

Requirements: appsec-baseline `requirements/security-requirements.md` @ `<sha not provided; working copy read>`
Artifacts reviewed: INT-0001.md @ `<sha not provided; working copy read>` (round 2)

## Triggers
| Trigger | True? | Why |
|---|---|---|
| INPUT | true | The CI verifier reads PR-supplied review reports and artifacts, which are untrusted (§ Trust assumptions). |
| ENDPOINT | false | "No change to the dogs-app web UI or API" (§ Visual). |
| WRITE | false | No app-level create/change/delete for callers. |
| FILE | false | No upload, storage or serving of user files; reports are repo files. |
| AUTHN | true | Operator identity for agent actions moves to the owner's laptop and Claude Code login; Anthropic federation rules and service accounts are deleted (§ What changes). |
| AUTHZ | true | Required checks, variables, labels and Actions allowlist change in lab-admin; the owner's merge is the gate. |
| CRYPTO | true | Reports bind to files with SHA-256 hashes (§ Trust assumptions). |
| DATA | false | The data table lists no personal or sensitive data. |
| LOG | false | No application or security logging change. |
| SECRET | true | Federation credentials and repo variables are removed; reports must never quote credentials. |
| DEP | true | New verifier scripts, pinned CI tools, appsec-baseline plugin as build input. |
| IAC | true | lab-admin Terraform changes (required checks, variables, labels, allowlist). |
| CI | true | security.yml, deploy.yml and author.yml change or are removed; new verifier and path-scoped scanners. |
| AI | true | New author and reviewer subagents, gate, fix loop and escalation. |

Spec must give full model IDs, maxTurns and the enforcement mechanism. |

## Summary
Covered (intent level): 8 · Missing: 0 · N/A: 23 (SR-017 by owner decision)

findings.evidence: Intent: "nothing stops it on a ZAP alert: accepted by the owner (2026-10-27) as a time-boxed exception until 0002." The time box is tied to a change, not a date, and the exceptions/ record (SR, reason, expiry) is not mentioned.
findings.recommendation: In the spec or plan, record this as an exceptions/ entry in appsec-baseline with the SR refs (SR-002, SR-020, SR-024), the reason and a calendar expiry date, so the gate can read it.

findings.evidence: Intent: "reviewers run on smaller models (Sonnet 5.5 or Haiku 4.5, set per agent); Opus 5.5 only for the main session". SR-031 requires models pinned by full ID and maxTurns set, and the intent names neither the full IDs nor maxTurns.
findings.recommendation: spec.md must state full model IDs and maxTurns per agent, the tool allow lists, and what enforces them (agent frontmatter, permission settings or hooks), each with a named test.
